class_i.multi_allotype_assignment: All donor HLA-I allotypes passing either tool threshold are retained; a single peptide may associate with multiple donor allotypes.
class_i.qc_filter: Technical replicates excluded if predicted binder fraction < 50% or length mode != 9 aa.

class_ii.multi_allotype_assignment: All donor HLA-II allotypes passing either tool threshold are retained; a single peptide may associate with multiple donor allotypes. Analyses without specified allele associations include detected peptides classified as non-binders.
class_ii.qc_filter: Technical replicates excluded if predicted binder fraction < 10% or length mode outside [12, 18] aa.

donor_hla_typing_provenance.method: NGS GS Junior Sequencer with Roche GS GType HLA Primer Sets (University Hospital Tuebingen)
donor_hla_typing_provenance.completeness: HLA-A/B/C complete; HLA-II reliable for HLA-DR only, incomplete for HLA-DP and HLA-DQ.

donor_hla_typing_provenance.method: Lung tissue exome sequencing + modified OptiType (github.com/FRED-2/OptiType tag hla-ligand-atlas)
donor_hla_typing_provenance.completeness: HLA-I and HLA-II inferred from exome sequencing.

donor_hla_typing_provenance.method: Sequence-based typing (Histogenetics: exons 1-8 for HLA-I, exons 2-6 for HLA-II)
donor_hla_typing_provenance.completeness: High-resolution SBT across HLA-I and HLA-II.
